protocol.trainer_execution_scope: Production L2LState/run_window/_store_for and L2LStep with standalone SGD. Does not invoke HF Trainer.training_step, gradient scaler, scheduler, checkpoint/resume or the complete HF optimizer orchestration.
protocol.windows: two full windows then max(1, k//2); unpadded variable sequence lengths

protocol.network: none; local fixture and optional attached files only; HF offline enabled
protocol.memory: observed RSS/CUDA and storage/budget accounting labelled separately
protocol.refusal_policy: Discard partial gradients, do not step, do not change router/input/seeds; continue every remaining predeclared window and every k.
